meta.title: Counter Offer Banner shown to the vendor on receipt of a counter offer
gaps: The catalog can verify that the vendor-facing page displays 'Counter Offer', but cannot specifically assert that it is rendered as a banner above the line-item or quote sheet rather than another vendor-page mention.

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation screen for the RFQ event.
Configure the event with an RFQ pricing stage.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a product for the vendor quote.
Invite one QA vendor who can submit the quote and receive the counter offer.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Confirm the vendor quote was accepted.
Open the buyer's comparison grid containing the vendor bid.
Send a buyer counter offer against the vendor's live quote.
Confirm the buyer grid records the counter offer as initiated.
Continue in the vendor-facing supplier portal.
Open this event's RFQ pricing view as the vendor.
Verify the vendor-facing page displays the pending counter offer notification.
